tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: Urinalysis shows significant leukocyturia, positive nitrites, hematuria, and bacteria, suggesting a urinary tract infection (UTI), despite negative urine culture (possibly due to prior antibiotics or fastidious organisms). Low specific gravity may indicate dilute urine. No proteinuria or ketonuria. Recommend clinical correlation and, if infection is suspected, consider repeat culture or further investigation.
